feature: Admin v4b · Venue menu rows and icons, hidden-venue crawl row, venue page gap
note: CONTACT_SHEET_ROLE=admin. Boards: 04-venues/the-menu (A3/03/venue-menu-states), 04-venues/hide-from-site, 04-venues/venue-overview and venue-mobile (the content column's gap:18px), 07/loading-venue-page. Read-only: rows open the ⋯ menu and look, never choose an item. The venue page is server-fetched, out of a route mock's reach, and the scratch branch has no hidden venue, so the pre-PR run points the web server's API at a local read-only proxy that answers GET /v1/admin/venues/<Ball Arena> with active:false (hidden Nov 2 by hugh, venue closed). Without that proxy the hidden-menu row draws Ball Arena's live menu and fails its wait. The menu rows settle after the header before the click: on the first cell of a run the click otherwise lands before hydration and the menu never opens. Not a row: the loading.tsx skeleton (07/loading-venue-page). The kit fails any cell with [aria-busy="true"] visible and has no per-row opt-in, so it was photographed in the pre-PR run (the same proxy holding GET /v1/admin/venues/<Larimer Lounge> 25 s, then a click from /admin/venues) and is walked by hand. Also hand-walked: a hidden venue whose crawl is paused (Resume row, RefreshCw), and a taken-down venue's menu.
